description: The user's characters: the people their photos are made of, each a set of selfies (the user, or someone who gave them written consent), or an invented adult the user made from a form in the app (fictional: true), which shoots like any other and takes no selfies. The default is the one last used, which start_shoot and add_selfie use when no character is passed. When the user has more than one and hasn't said who a shoot is of, ask.

space.description: The space, by its id or name from list_spaces; left out, the personal one, but a shoot names one when the user is in several. When they haven't said which, ask.

name: list_characters
title: List characters
